# Indi Logo Assets

Static logo files for use in email signatures and other external contexts.

## Bare mark (transparent background)

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `logo.svg` | Mark, vector, full color |
| `logo-64.png` | Mark, 64x64px |
| `logo-256.png` | Mark, 256x256px |
| `logo-512.png` | Mark, 512x512px |

## Mono ink (dark, for light backgrounds)

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `logo-mono-ink.svg` | Mono ink mark, vector |
| `logo-mono-ink-512.png` | Mono ink mark, 512x512px |

## Mono white (for dark backgrounds)

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `logo-mono-white.svg` | Mono white mark, vector |
| `logo-mono-white-512.png` | Mono white mark, 512x512px |

## Reversed

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `logo-reversed.svg` | Reversed mark, vector |
| `logo-reversed-512.png` | Reversed mark, 512x512px |

## Tile (mark on rounded dark square, for app icons)

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `logo-tile.svg` | Tile icon, vector |
| `logo-tile-180.png` | Tile icon, 180x180px |
| `logo-tile-512.png` | Tile icon, 512x512px |

## Favicon

| File | Description |
|---|---|
| `logo-16.png` | Favicon, 16x16px |
| `logo-32.png` | Favicon, 32x32px |
| `logo.ico` | Favicon, .ico |
